meta.name: Velocity
meta.notes: Primary is the racing stripe (hero title band, ticker, CTA band, P1 badge, start lights, streak wipes) always paired with on-primary text and a hairline edge so near-black brands stay visible; accent is a secondary pin-stripe only.

issues: Homepage dies after the product grid: categories, story, gallery, quote and CTA render as ~2000px of empty asphalt because reveal is tied to IntersectionObserver only and the 3s fallback is disabled once the main script runs (desktop, mobile and stress brand all broken)
The signature speed-streak wipe is coupled to content visibility, so if the observer misses a section, the content stays hidden too
Hero race number '01' is tucked behind the header and hero image, almost invisible, so the 'huge race numbers behind content' idea barely reads
Background race numbers stroked at 9% alpha are too faint to register on the noise texture
The product 'starting grid' has no grid of its own: no racing stripe or track markings, so it reads like a generic 4-up shop grid
Product cards stretch to the row height, which leaves a big dead gap between the product name and the price
Typography (italic condensed uppercase), the lap-timer strip, the parallelogram crops and the P1-P4 badges are strong, and the stress brand holds up well
fixed: Split reveal into 'in' (content visible) and 'wipe' (streak animation). Sections are now also revealed from the scroll loop as soon as their top passes 80% of the viewport, and a 3.2s safety net makes all content visible while still playing the streak wipe when each section arrives
Moved the hero race number to bottom-left at up to 42rem, with a brand-colour stroke and a gradient fill, so it reads as a giant number painted on the car behind the copy, with parallax kept
Raised the stroke contrast of the background race numbers from 9% to 13%
Added a diagonal brand-colour racing stripe with an accent pinstripe across the top of the products section, and dashed grid-slot track markings behind the P1/P2… cards
Cards now align to the top (align-self:start), so the price sits right under the product name
